proof_policy.repository: CI and focused tests may prove code, configuration, contracts, and simulated lifecycle behavior.
proof_policy.host: Only Jacob's Mac may prove installed Open WebUI state, launchd, credentials, provider availability, real tools, and persisted chats.
proof_policy.completion_rule: No slice is fully complete until its repository checks and applicable host acceptance checks both pass on the final PR head.

criteria.statement: Open WebUI 0.10.2 is isolated, owner-only, and cannot bind unauthenticated service traffic beyond loopback.
criteria.acceptance: bootstrap succeeds; lsof shows 127.0.0.1:3000; the installed process uses the isolated venv and service directory

criteria.statement: Open WebUI receives only the required runtime variables and Kitty Gateway credential, never ambient provider or developer secrets.
criteria.acceptance: verify passes; launchd process environment contains no PYTHONPATH, provider keys, GitHub token, or unrelated credentials

criteria.statement: Exactly one usable admin account exists with no pending-account wall.
criteria.acceptance: bootstrap repairs the live database idempotently and the browser opens directly into a usable workspace

criteria.statement: Start, stop, restart, login startup, PID ownership, and port collisions are handled without killing or claiming unrelated processes.
criteria.acceptance: up/down/install-autostart survive repeated cycles and a login restart without a port race or false success

criteria.statement: A real provider stream reaches Open WebUI, ends cleanly, and exposes actionable provider failures.
criteria.acceptance: smoke --accept-charges returns the bounded expected response and a forced provider failure remains visible and schema-valid

criteria.statement: Chats persist across restart; backup, restore, and rollback preserve data and service boundaries.
criteria.acceptance: a named chat survives restart, verified backup/restore returns the expected database state, and rollback opens the canonical Kitty UI

criteria.statement: The visible menu contains only routes the active provider policy can honor.
criteria.acceptance: verify sees Auto, Fast, Think, Code, and Vision in auto/OpenRouter mode, or one honest provider-labelled row in exact-provider mode

criteria.statement: Fast, Think, Code, and Vision remain pinned when selected; only Auto reclassifies.
criteria.acceptance: verify --accept-charges returns a nonempty answer from every advertised route

criteria.statement: Auto preserves domain-aware deep routing and sends image turns to the vision route.
criteria.acceptance: a domain-deep prompt records the deep route and an uploaded image succeeds without manually selecting Vision

criteria.statement: Direct OpenRouter fallback uses native provider/model identifiers rather than LiteLLM-only prefixes.
criteria.acceptance: with LiteLLM intentionally unavailable, each advertised route either succeeds through direct OpenRouter or fails with the exact actionable cause

criteria.statement: Open WebUI receives only the bounded authenticated Kitty tool server, not the full Gateway schema.
criteria.acceptance: verify finds exactly the intended memory, notes, projects, next-step, calendar, Tutor, and Builder operations; unauthenticated calls fail

criteria.statement: Memory, notes, projects, calendar, Tutor, and Builder answer from their owning domain projections without mutating read-only state.
criteria.acceptance: verify probes every read surface; empty or disconnected states are identified honestly rather than reported as generic success

criteria.statement: Life projects precede code projects and tool result sizes cannot flood a paid prompt.
criteria.acceptance: live project output is life-first and all bounded query parameters reject invalid or excessive limits

criteria.statement: At least one configured tool-capable agent emits and completes a real Kitty tool call through Open WebUI.
criteria.acceptance: Daily Kitty answers a project-status question using the Kitty tool server, with tool execution visible in the response trace

criteria.statement: Daily Kitty, Research, Coding, Tutor, and Builder Operator exist idempotently with the intended base route, tools, and vision capability.
criteria.acceptance: verify inspects all five live model records and rejects any drift

criteria.statement: Daily Kitty is the default and the purposeful agent set is pinned without duplicate or stale rows.
criteria.acceptance: the fresh browser session opens on Daily Kitty and all five intended agents are immediately selectable

criteria.statement: Ollama discovery, telemetry, community sharing, update checks, arena models, and persistent database overrides are disabled for the controlled shell.
criteria.acceptance: verify matches the live runtime against the checked-in hardened settings

criteria.statement: Every agent can complete a bounded real turn through its configured route.
criteria.acceptance: run one small live turn through each agent and record failures by agent and route

slices.reason: Image Studio and James work were removed from PR #384 and preserved on feat/image-studio-next-four. They must not be mixed into the daily-driver baseline before this PR passes final acceptance.

blocking_gates.statement: pytest, lint, typecheck, hygiene, Kitty Chat, browser smoke, and PR description checks are green on the final head
python3 scripts/openwebui_local.py bootstrap --accept-charges passes on Jacob's Mac
python3 scripts/openwebui_local.py verify --accept-charges passes after bootstrap and restart
an independent reviewer examines the final head and all actionable findings are resolved
